# Finite-Time Singularity Formation for the Three-Dimensional Euler Equations

> Finite-Time Singularity Formation for the Three-Dimensional Euler Equations, by Levent Alpöge, Tristan Buckmaster and Matei P. Coiculescu, read beside its Lean. Paper and Lean by Levent Alpöge, Tristan Buckmaster and Matei P. Coiculescu, from their repository mcoiculescu/EulerBlowupPublic at fd3a158; their paper thanks Anthropic for supporting the collaboration from which it grew. The reading copy is set from their TeX of the arXiv version, with their numbering. The links from sentences to the Lean, the plain titles, the notes on the Lean and the comparisons were made with AI and have not been reviewed by the authors. Our files are MIT-licensed

The links from the text to the Lean, the plain titles, the reading notes and the comparisons were made with AI and have not been reviewed by the authors. No mathematician has reviewed them.

## Read

- [Finite-Time Singularity Formation for the Three-Dimensional Euler Equations](https://wcook04.github.io/library/euler/)

## Data

All data is static JSON under https://wcook04.github.io/library/euler/edition/. Start at edition/index.json: it maps API routes to files.

The Lean index has 729 modules and 9,297 declarations.
